basis: Tennant’s February 23, 2026 release establishes the threshold crossing. Consolidated GAAP net sales for the three months ended December 31, 2025 were $291.6 million, down 11.3% from $328.9 million in Q4 2024 and below the $312.455 million cutoff. The upper_bound field records that verified actual. The earliest public date remains unresolved. The conference hosts’ records establish the events and narrow the ROTH appearance to scheduled investor meetings, but I could not verify Tennant’s public remarks or presentation materials for the November 13 Baird or December 11 Oppenheimer appearances.

coverage.detail: February 17, 2025. The prior-year release independently confirms Q4 2024 net sales of $328.9 million. Its 2025 sales outlook covered the full year.
April 30 Q1 release. The $1.210–$1.250 billion net sales range covered fiscal 2025.
August 6 Q2 release. Tennant reaffirmed the same full-year range and scheduled its call for August 7. The release supplied no Q4 sales ceiling.

The third-party Q2 call transcript also places the dollar range in fiscal 2025. Management discussed second-half productivity and margin expectations without stating a qualifying Q4 reported sales upper bound.
September investor deck. The 3%–5% sales growth target was long-term and organic. The deck supplied no Q4 2025 consolidated reported sales ceiling.

November 3 Q3 release. Tennant anticipated strong Q4 momentum and reaffirmed annual net sales of $1.210–$1.250 billion. Subtracting reported nine-month sales of $911.9 million implies $298.1–$338.1 million for Q4. That secondary calculation has a high end above the cutoff.
The 19-page Q3 earnings deck discusses Q4 momentum. Slide 10 gives the $1.210–$1.250 billion sales range as full-year guidance.

November 4 call, third-party transcript. CEO Dave Huml put Q4 sales needed for the guidance midpoint at approximately $318 million, already above the cutoff. His approximately $311 million comparison referred to Q4 2024 after removing an estimated backlog benefit. Management announced the Baird, ROTH and Oppenheimer appearances.

Tennant’s public archive rendered its archive heading. The year-filtered URL https://investors.tennantco.com/events-and-presentations/default.aspx?Year=2025 was inaccessible through the web reader. The quarterly-results archive at https://investors.tennantco.com/financials/quarterly-results/default.aspx also yielded no readable November 4 replay link. Searches of Tennant’s IR site and presentation CDN recovered the earnings deck but no event-specific 2025 conference deck.

November 13 Baird appearance. The host’s recap covers the conference in aggregate. A verified webcast for another participant identified Baird’s event platform at https://wsw.com/webcast/baird81/carr/1910104. The event root https://wsw.com/webcast/baird81/ and candidate paths https://wsw.com/webcast/baird81/tnc/ and https://wsw.com/webcast/baird81/tennant/ were inaccessible. A search for Tennant within that event returned no replay or transcript.
The Tennant-specific Baird deck found in the issuer’s archive carries a November 13, 2024 cover date, one year before the appearance under review.

November 19 ROTH appearance. ROTH’s own announcement lists Tennant and schedules prearranged one-on-one and small-group meetings from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. The event directory at https://events.investorbrandnetwork.com/2025/roth-tech/ also lists Tennant. Neither source yielded public Tennant remarks, a recording or a quarterly forecast.

December 11 Oppenheimer appearance. The host’s event page confirms the December 10–11 virtual summit. Its archive at https://www.oppenheimer.com/events describes its conferences as invitation-only. The summit page provides no Tennant session recording, transcript or slides. Public disclosure at this appearance remains unverified.
February 3 Regulation FD filing. Item 7.01 sets the annual meeting and director nomination deadline. It supplies no sales estimate.
February 13 filing. The exhibit concerns board appointments and a cooperation agreement. Its company profile cites 2024 annual sales and supplies no Q4 2025 sales estimate.
February 17 scheduling notice. Tennant scheduled results for after the February 23 market close and the call for February 24. The notice supplied no preliminary sales figure.

Reopened the issuer release and SEC Exhibit 99.1. Both report $291.6 million versus $328.9 million in their quarterly columns. The acquisition contribution was zero, and currency added 2.6 percentage points to the 13.9% organic decline, yielding the reported 11.3% decline.
EDGAR identifies Exhibit 99.1 as the February 23 release, records acceptance at 19:02:30 on February 23 and assigns a February 24 filing date.

publication_date_evidence: Tennant’s IR page displays 02/23/2026. The SEC exhibit carries the same dateline and announces the results that day. This verifies publication of the actuals on February 23. The missing conference records prevent verification that it was the earliest qualifying communication.
